messages.subject_clean: [MplusAutomation] Re: Getting Standarized Parameter estimates from an OUT(Mplus)
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Thank you for sending this.  It seems to be a problem with the standardized estimates, but I am not sure why.  MplusAutomation reads the model correctly, apparently, both the raw and standardized estimates.  semPaths() works well for unstandardized, but not the standardized results.  I am copying Sacha Epskamp who developed the semPlot package on this.

Cheers,

Josh

library(texreg)
library(semPlot)

m <- readModels("BRSQ.out")

messages.subject: Re: Mixtures with class covariates.
messages.body_plain:
Hi Josué,

Thanks for letting us know about the problem when the section you mentioned was present. We hadn't encountered that section header before, so the parsing code was not recognizing it as a header. I updated the version of the package on Github (https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation) to handle this section, and your output appears to read properly now. I also just uploaded a new version of the package to CRAN that mostly includes a number of bug fixes from the past year. So, the fix for your problem should be available through CRAN in a few days, or you can install directly from Github.

Best,
Michael

messages.subject: Re: errors on runModels()
messages.body_plain:
Hi Siwachoat,

I would check your mplus input files, as well as the corresponding .out files to see what error occurred. A non-zero exit status of Mplus means an error has occurred, and the information about that error should be in the .out file. Feel free to attach a .inp and/or .out file here if you need more input.

Michael
